0022600185.text: The Lakers (6-2) visit the Kings (1-6) riding a two-game winning streak, sitting 1st in the Pacific and 4th in the West, while Sacramento is 15th in the West and 4.5 games back in the division after winning its most recent game. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), and Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Daeqwon Plowden (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Lakers won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 128-104 win in Los Angeles on March 1.
